query: Key contributions and follow-ups of 'Attention Is All You Need' (2017) for engineers
highlights: The paper 'Attention Is All You Need' introduced the Transformer model which relies solely on attention mechanisms without recurrent or convolutional layers [1].
The Transformer architecture has been influential in natural language processing, leading to advancements in machine translation and text generation tasks [1].
Follow-up research has explored integrating Transformer models into various engineering applications, such as automated design and predictive maintenance [Insufficient evidence [ref]].
There is a growing interest in applying Transformer models to solve complex engineering problems, including but not limited to signal processing and data analysis [Insufficient evidence [ref]].
